description:
Dimensions of the Lot are (Approximately) 100.00 x 65.00 x 100.00 x 65.00
Nearest Cross Street: Leonardville Road
Subject to a Mortgage given to Wells Fargo Bank, N.A. on August 26/ 2013, in the approximate amount of $69,000.00, recorded on September 11, 2013, in Book 9035, at Page 8617.
The sale is subject to any unpaid taxes and assessments, tax, water, and sewer liens and other municipal assessments. The amount due can be obtained from the local taxing authority. Pursuant to NJSA 46:8B-21 the sale may also be subject to the limited lien priority of any Condominium / Homeowner Association liens which may exist. The sale may be further subject to Restrictions, reversions, reservations, and easements of record. The occupancy status of the subject property is unknown.
The approximate upset sum is $136,962.91 calculated through November 11, 2025 plus any additional advance, interest, Sheriff's cost and commission to the date of the sale.
